scope: Initial schema probe versus formal all-directory camera inventory
formal_inventory_method: ijson streaming; only allowlisted camera/path/pose/timestamp subtrees materialized; no ground_info value consumer
initial_schema_probe: Before writing the full inventory, one representative metadata container per platform was parsed with the standard json parser to inspect only top-level key names and the camera whitelist. That parser transiently materializes the full JSON container. No ground_info key, target bbox/class/positive_map/caption value was selected, inspected, printed or used.
claim_boundary: Do not generalize the formal streaming-inventory no-annotation-materialization statement to every initial schema-probe parser operation. Both paths opened annotation-containing containers; neither supplied annotation values to model, selection, scoring or G.
